# `runtime` package: architecture note excerpt

Full note: `knowledge/architecture/runtime.md`; update it in the same change (skill `notes`).

## Responsibility

- Execute coalition jobs concurrently, skip duplicates, keep generated text for scoring, persist the Run archive (`knowledge/concepts/Run archive.md`), cache prompt prefixes for backends that can reuse them, and collect timings.

## Invariants

- A coalition key identifies one generation request; duplicate keys reuse the stored text.
- A run either finishes (`mark_complete`) or leaves an archive `reanalyze` refuses; no partial success is reported.
- No "Task exception was never retrieved" warnings: every task belongs to the task group.
- `RunArchive.load` never writes: reading an archive leaves its files byte-identical.

## Known issues

- None open. Fixed: C02, C06, C07 (Fixed issues (`knowledge/issues/Fixed issues.md`)).
